name: multi-claude-desktop
description: Run several Claude Desktop accounts side by side, one isolated profile folder each
author: tohidmalik002 (https://github.com/tohidmalik002)

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-packager . "Multi Claude Desktop" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --asar --executable-name="Multi Claude Desktop" --icon=assets/icon.ico --ignore=^/src --ignore=^/scripts --ignore=^/release --ignore=^/tsconfig
